name: AppearanceSettings
description:
A ready-made appearance panel: every preference the appearance runtime stores, as setting
rows in groups, applied as soon as they change and remembered per person. Put it in a
SettingsDialog section, a Sheet or a page; it needs an AppearanceProvider above it.
Settings the application locked are shown fixed (or hidden), and lists follow
`definePalette` and `defineBackground`.
signature: ({ sections, backgrounds, palettes, locked, reset, labels, className, }: AppearanceSettingsProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: backgrounds
props.description: Backgrounds to offer, in order. Default: every registered background (`BACKGROUNDS`).

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ theme: string; mode: string; modeDescription: string; light: string; dark: string; system: string; palette: string; paletteDescription: string; custom: string; accent: string; accentDescription: string; accent2: string; accent2Description: string; tint: string; tintDescription: string; colourDefault: string; background: string; backgroundDescription: string; picture: string; pictureDescription: string; choosePicture: string; removePicture: string; pictureError: string; display: string; material: string; materialDescription: string; glass: string; frosted: string; solid: string; density: string; densityDescription: string; comfortable: string; compact: string; motion: string; motionDescription: string; motionSystem: string; animated: string; still: string; size: string; sizeDescription: string; shape: string; radius: string; lineWeight: string; fonts: string; fontSans: string; fontDisplay: string; fontMono: string; fontMatch: string; locked: string; reset: string; }> | undefined

props.name: locked
props.description:
What a setting the application locked with `configureAppearance({ locked })` looks like:
`"disable"` (default) shows it, unchangeable, with "Set by your organisation"; `"hide"` leaves it out.

props.name: palettes
props.description: Palettes to offer. Default: every registered palette (`PALETTES`).

props.name: reset
props.description: Show a "Reset to defaults" button after the groups. Default true.

props.name: sections
props.description: Which groups to show, in this order. Default: theme, colours, background, display and size.
